**Razorgrain Soup** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

Razorgrain boiled in water and made into a soup.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Razorgrain (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Razorgrain | | Razorgrain Soup (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station after having picked Razorgrain for the first time.
- May be bought from Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- Can be found in the Communist Collectron Station, when it is run in "Proletariat" mode.
